slides.title: Most Cyber Listings Close in a Week
slides.subtitle: Speed beats perfection in job hunting

bullets: Set job alerts on LinkedIn and Indeed
Apply within 48 hours of a posting
Have a CV ready before you need it
Follow up once - then move on

caption: Most cyber job listings get flooded in the first 72 hours. If you're waiting to feel ready, the role is already gone. Speed is a skill. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #jobsearch #cypherjobs #careertips
